meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上装好 claude-mem 后,本机会跑一个 worker(默认 127.0.0.1)为每个 agent 监听对话转录,并在真实任务开始时经 MCP 注入记忆上下文,同时把实时 INDEX 写进 memory log。不需要 Cursor。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 时触发:默认是本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro observer,也可选 host-login observer 或远程 cmem.ai。原文写明不需要 Cursor。
howto.what_en: After installing claude-mem on Grok Bot, a local worker (default 127.0.0.1) watches each agent transcript, injects memory context via MCP when a real task starts, and writes a live INDEX into the memory log. No Cursor required.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up claude-mem on Grok Bot: the default local worker plus CMEM Pro observer, an optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. Cursor is not required.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default CMEM Pro observer
say_en.note: Starts the local worker; no --provider flag

say_en.text: Install with --provider host to use the host-login observer
Install a remote setup with --runtime server at https://cmem.ai
